svg.text: Figure 2. Outcome per task and arm (stage C and CTF v2)
Rows sorted by CTFTiny difficulty. One trajectory per cell.
Stage C: 240 s / 24 calls, earlier harness. v2: 1,200 s / 50 calls.
Heretic was not run in stage C. Stage C and v2 differ in harness and budget and are not pooled.
